verdict.rationale: Deel is a global payroll and HR SaaS platform, not an AI agent or assistant. Consuming third-party MCP servers is an MCP-client role that falls outside this product category. The evidence documents only Deel's own MCP server, which exposes Deel tools to external clients such as Claude and Cursor. That is the opposite, server-side role and cannot be credited to this client story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
